translations.translatedText: # Wednesday 25.8.2021 (radio)
Finland is evacuating the security staff of the Afghan embassy. There are 574 new corona infections. A school peace has been declared in Finland. The weather is rainy.
## Evacuation

![Afghans waiting to be evacuated at Kabul airport on 24 August 2021. A small child sits on a suitcase and looks at one of the aeroplanes.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5184,h_2916,x_0,y_0/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-8457146125165187662/1629866357)
Open image viewer
Tens of thousands of people have been evacuated out of Afghanistan in recent days. Photo: AFP / Lehtikuva

Finland will stop bringing people out of Afghanistan by Friday at the latest. There are still about 170 people in Afghanistan waiting to get into Finland. About 250 people have been brought to Finland from Afghanistan.
Finland is also bringing out of Afghanistan the security guards who worked at the embassy in Afghanistan. The government decided on the matter late on Tuesday.
Foreign Minister Pekka Haavisto says that not everyone may have time to be brought to Finland.
## Corona figures
![Vaccination point inside Rovaniemi City Hall.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_2016,h_1134,x_0,y_189/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-844124611e702a78628/1629384816)
Open image viewer
Vaccination point inside Rovaniemi City Hall. Photo: mia.sivula@yle.fi
There are 574 new corona infections in Finland. In 2 weeks there have been over 9,500 infections. This is a little less than 2 weeks earlier.
There are 98 people in hospital care because of the coronavirus. Of them, 23 are in intensive care. About 47 percent of all people in Finland have now received both corona vaccines.
## YIT's redundancy negotiations
![Two cranes belonging to construction company YIT.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-11908720)
Open image viewer
Two cranes belonging to construction company YIT. Photo: AOP
Large construction company YIT is starting redundancy negotiations. The aim is to cut at most 200 employees in Finland. The negotiations concern white-collar employees.
YIT has about 4,400 employees in Finland in total.
## School peace

![Marie Rautava, programme director of the Mannerheim League for Child Welfare, and musician Ailu Valle at the school peace declaration in Sodankylä on Wednesday 25.8.2021.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_4032,h_2268,x_0,y_378/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-8458896125ee1b62b04/1629878295)
Open image viewer
Marie Rautava, programme director of the Mannerheim League for Child Welfare, and musician Ailu Valle in a joint photo before the school peace declaration. Photo: Inger-Elle Suoninen / Yle
School peace has been declared for the whole of Finland in Sodankylä.
This year's theme is a safe school. With this, people want to be reminded that children must be safe at school. Nobody may be bullied at school, and nobody may be left alone.
This was the 31st time that school peace has been declared.
## Heavy rain

![People photographed in rainy weather in Kallio on 18.8.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5420,h_3049,x_0,y_466/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-843802611e200ad7523/1629370507)
Open image viewer
In places as much as 50 millimetres of water may accumulate. Picture from Kallio, Helsinki, on 18 August. Photo: Hilma Toivonen / Yle
The weather is rainy. In the west and south, tens of millimetres of water fall. In places as much as 50 millimetres of rain falls.

The Finnish Meteorological Institute warns that a lot of rain will fall especially in Uusimaa, Kanta-Häme and Päijät-Häme. The rain may cause floods. Cars must be driven carefully, because on a wet road a car may start to skid.
On Wednesday it is also windy. On Thursday less rain falls. In the north it is dry, and the sun also shines at times.
